trigger: doc-repo-bd (cross-session message): item 9's fix (PR #87, overlayDistricts/maxImperviousCoverPct not-applicable) had been fixed AND --apply'd since my earlier close doc, but publish-gate-sched.mjs's SLATE_1_RAIL_KEYS (the hourly scheduler's default --rail set) never included either rail -- the gate had literally never once evaluated them. doc-repo-bd ran a one-time manual catch-up to land a real verdict, then asked for a proper fix: wire both into the default slate, but ONLY after confirming maxImperviousCoverPct (Travis-only writer, refuses every other county outright) can't produce a false 'refuse' for the 5 counties it structurally never touches.

investigation.confirmedTheGap: Read publish-gate-sched.mjs directly: SLATE_1_RAIL_KEYS was exactly the 5 named rails from _decisions/2026-09-02_step7_consumer_c_then_b.md; overlayDistricts/maxImperviousCoverPct were absent, and parseGateSchedFlags defaults to that list whenever --rail is omitted -- confirmed the hourly trigger passes no --rail override, so this was real, not a misreading.
investigation.confirmedTheRisk: Read parcel-max-impervious-cover.mjs: parseParcelMaxImperviousCoverFlags REFUSES (COUNTY_NOT_IN_SCOPE) any county except Travis (48453) -- the writer cannot write ANY cell state, not even not-applicable, for the other 5 program counties. Naively adding this rail to the default slate without checking further could plausibly have made those 5 counties refuse on this rail forever.
investigation.tracedTheActualMechanism: Read the vendored engine's evaluateRailGate (publish-gate.js) and loadCountyRailCells/loadCountyRailCellsPage (load.js), and cell-state.js's isEarnedCell/isUnaccounted definitions. Two separate checks, easy to conflate: isEarnedCell (value/absent-verified/refused -- NOT not-applicable) decides whether a rail is 'live' in a county at all (zero earned cells -> excludedDeclaredAhead, i.e. 'excluded'); isUnaccounted (kind==='unaccounted' only) decides the actual pass/refuse count, and correctly does NOT count not-applicable cells as a gap. loadCountyRailCells is strictly bounded to one county's place_key range (WHERE place_key > county: AND place_key < county; ) -- a hard-scoped writer's untouched county can never leak another county's earned cells into its own evaluation.
investigation.foundZeroExistingTestCoverage: evaluateRailGate and loadCountyRailCells had no test coverage anywhere in this repo before this session, despite being the core mechanism the entire gate scheduler depends on. Did not rely on code-reading alone -- wrote test/gate-county-scoped-rail.test.mjs (6 tests) against the REAL functions (not mocks), including the exact falsifier doc-repo-bd asked for: a county with zero earned cells for a hard-scoped rail reads excludedDeclaredAhead -> 'excluded', never a false 'refuse'.
investigation.liveVerificationAttempted_blockedByConte: Tried three times to get a live per-county cell-state breakdown for both rails (full 2-rail sweep, a targeted single-county/single-rail query, and a retry on the corrected FACTORY_DATABASE_URL_REPLICA) to confirm the writer --apply doc-repo-bd mentioned had actually completed everywhere. All three hit real Postgres statement timeouts -- contention was worse at this point than earlier in the session. Did not force further attempts; proceeded on code-level verification alone, since the SAFETY of wiring these rails in does not depend on current data completeness (an honest 'refuse' on a genuinely-incomplete county is the correct signal, not a bug -- see governing decision _decisions/2026-09-01_parcel_record_is_the_gate_to_everything.md).

fix.whatChanged: Added SLATE_1B_RAIL_KEYS = [overlayDistricts, maxImperviousCoverPct] and DEFAULT_SCHED_RAIL_KEYS = [...SLATE_1_RAIL_KEYS, ...SLATE_1B_RAIL_KEYS]; parseGateSchedFlags now defaults to DEFAULT_SCHED_RAIL_KEYS. SLATE_1_RAIL_KEYS itself is left untouched (still exactly the 5 rails the decision doc names), so that constant keeps its own falsifier test's meaning ('matches the decision's named slate exactly') true -- the two new rails are a separate, explicitly-named addition, not folded silently into a differently-scoped constant.
fix.testEvidence: test/gate-county-scoped-rail.test.mjs (new, 6 tests, against the real engine functions) + test/publish-gate-sched.test.mjs (updated slate-pinning tests, one new end-to-end test through runPublishGateSched proving a maxImperviousCoverPct out-of-scope county writes 'excluded' and Travis writes a real 'pass').
